A promise to "drink our fill of the milk of the white goat" is made in this composer's setting of a poem beginning, "Come with me, under my coat." The landscape in Fra Bartolomeo's Madonna and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist quotes from the background of this artist's Virgin and Child and Two Angels in the Uffizi. This composer provided the complete mass Propers for the major feasts of the Roman liturgy in his109-piece Gradualia. This composer created a set of eight variations on the tune The Carman's Whistle. After the dress rehearsal of this opera, a royal decree forced a hasty rewrite to compose the disastrousBuondelmente, and the composer of this opera supposedly dismissed a possible rewrite by scribbling in themargins "But it's ugly!" Its second movement is not marked Poco adagio as thought for over acentury, but Andante and is an F major siciliana in 6/8 time. It was composed for Count Thun during a stopover on its composer's return from visiting hisfather-in-law in Salzburg. Identify this Mozart symphony named for an Austrian city.

In one section of this work, two naked women hold corn and apples, and between them is a long panel featuring a cross section of the earth's crust and a baby cradled in the roots of a tree. Giant hands rise from a yellow mountain in one part of this series, while other scenes show a golden-haired Christ-like infant receiving a vaccination, with a nurse and doctor representing Mary and Joseph. At the 1982 Proms, Sir Roger Norrington pleaded for a modern performable version of this work in English translation. One character sings a cavatina about how "Light and Life are both enfeebled," and in the first aria, one character sings about he is driving his team along, cheered by a simple song.
